title: 方外观 Fangwai Guan
subtitle: Fang Wai Kuan, A Look Abroad · Xiyang Lou

model.line: Simple massing of a European palace: position and footprint from the ruin, the plan or a survey, heights read from the plates of the 1780s (research/xiyanglou/boxes.csv). Not a detailed model yet; the figures and their methods are in the Dimensions block.
rows: hall, porch and curved stairs, as the plan draws them: 24.6 × 13.3 m, eave 1 m, ridge 1 m
hall, two storeys, 3 bays, double eaves: 14 × 7 m, eave 8.9 m, ridge 13 m
by the stone kit, the kit's reading of the plates, C, not a detailed model

questions.title: The plan's scale and turn in this strip (Round 6)
Each European front as the plates draw it

evidence.title: Plate VIII: 方外观 Fangwai Guan
evidence.excerpt_other: Sous cet avant-corps est pratiqué un souterrain, dans lequel on pénètre par une porte, accompagnée à droite et à gauche d'une espèce d'œil de bœuf grillé;
evidence.summary: Small building on a terrace, three windows, rusticated pilasters at the ends. Under the projecting terrace a low room with a door and two grilled oeil-de-boeuf, thought to be for coolness. Round stairs at each end. On the left an open octagonal pavilion beyond a canal with a rich bridge.

evidence.title: Engraving 8: 方外观 Fangwai Guan
evidence.excerpt_other: From the sides of this building ostentatious circular stairways led downward from the second floor.
evidence.summary: Circular stairs at the sides from the second floor; bridge over the moat with carved marble scroll balustrades.

evidence.title: Detail gain, 3 plates against the catalogue thumbs
evidence.locator: crops cmp08, cmp12, cmp15, cmp01 in palace_r6_tmp_plates
evidence.summary: Same regions at 900 px. Plate 8 (P0048): window lattice, shading hatch and baluster ornament resolve, thumb showed them as texture. Plate 12 (P0052): door panel pattern and urn outlines clear. Plate 15 (P0055): water drops and fountain tiers separate, thumb mashes them. Original is 2.6 times wider than the thumb. Plate 1 Chester Beatty against Palace Museum: 2.7 times wider again and far darker: roof tile, hatch and capitals sharp.

evidence.title: Choutzé 1876: a visit to the European ruins
evidence.excerpt_other: Ce qui reste de ces bâtiments de style italien est encore superbe. Un seul pavillon a conservé son toit fait dans le goût chinois, en tuiles violettes et vertes vernissées ; les autres n'ont debout que leurs quatre murs de pierre décorés d'ornements de faïence de toutes couleurs.
evidence.summary: Earliest dated colour statement of the roofs that I found: violet and green glazed tile on a Chinese-type roof, faience of all colours on stone walls. He also says the emperors never lived there: unsupported.

evidence.title: 圆明园五朝御制诗文集注 v4, editors' note on 西洋楼
evidence.summary: The editors walk the strip from west to east with completion dates and plaques: 谐奇趣 1751, 养雀笼 1759, then the fountains and the perspective walls, with their mechanical details. They put the whole at about 2% of the gardens.

evidence.title: 西洋楼水法图
evidence.locator: 国家图书馆善本部 none shown
evidence.summary: Plan of the Xiyang Lou waterworks across its dozen sites; the record shows no shelf number. No image here; the site may ask a small payment for the full record.

evidence.title: Teng Gu's preface on the photographs and plan
evidence.locator: pp.3-5 of the preface, djvu pages 5-7
evidence.summary: Teng Gu says the photographs and the plan belonged to Ernst Boerschmann and were taken and drawn by Ohlmer, a customs official in Tianjin who lived in Beijing 1867-1879 and whose collection went to the Hildesheim museum. He argues they are earlier than those in Favier's Péking (1897), Combaz 1909, Perzynski 1920 and Münsterberg 1912, naming pages he compared. Fig. 13 is a recent photograph by Zhou Zuanwu; fig. 15 is copied from Favier p.264.

evidence.title: Three plans by Antoine Durand: 1984 from Jin Xun at 1/500 inside Adam's 1/10000; 1985 from a survey of the whole site; 1987 fountain area from 128 surveyed points with a manual survey of all surface parts
evidence.summary: The only published method statement for an on-site survey of the whole strip. Only excavation could fix the east fence of the gardens and the east edge of the basin. The west edge of the 线法山 gate and the ramp fix the geometry. See R0139-R0143. Plans without a printed scale in the copy I read.

evidence.title: 西洋楼区域考古勘探报告
evidence.locator: mhymy 档案史料 12205, free part
evidence.summary: Report's opening: the strip runs 860 m east-west, up to 300 m wide in the west and 65 m at its narrowest, about 70,000 m2, built 1747-1783. A central axis divides it into about five sections, each with its own north-south axis, thirteen units from 谐奇趣 to 线法墙. Survey results are paywalled.

reconstructions.title: 方外观, image 765 in a gallery
Plan de l'aire du belvedere (Fig. 2 in S603), Jin Xun's drawing
reconstructions.creator: 金勋 Jin Xun
reconstructions.why: S603: Jin Xun, of an architect family that worked on the garden, drew in 1924 plans and elevations of the European palaces, twelve published in Adam 1936. Scale drawings with water pipes, levels and paving; some detail suggests original documents; the rest from site observation and engravings. S603 lists errors.
reconstructions.caveat: A modern reconstruction drawing, not a Qing document.
reconstructions.licence: none stated; S597 gives the author dates 1881-1976 in one place and 1883-1976 in another

reconstructions.title: Fig. 9, Plan du belvedere (plan de restitution 1984)
reconstructions.creator: Antoine Durand
reconstructions.why: Detailed survey of all surface remains identified from old photos: base, courses of side stairs, pilasters, door jamb, fragments of pilaster, architrave and cornice.
reconstructions.licence: none stated on the Persee page

reconstructions.title: Fig. 12, Facade sud du belvedere (restitution 1984)
reconstructions.creator: Antoine Durand
reconstructions.why: Plan, then elevation from surveyed base and pilasters; arches, oculi, balusters from fragments and Ohlmer's photo; spandrels invented from a shell fragment at 海晏堂; stair ornaments geometric, from Ohlmer; roofs hypothetical, ornaments from the engraving.
reconstructions.licence: none stated on the Persee page

reconstructions.title: Fig. 4, Plan d'ensemble (plan de restitution 1985)
reconstructions.creator: Antoine Durand
reconstructions.archive: Mission Palais d'Ete, under Michele Pirazzoli-t'Serstevens
reconstructions.why: Three stages: 1984 plan from Jin Xun's plan fragments in Adam 1936, on the 1:10,000 park plan at 1:500, corrected by site readings and engravings; 1985 plan from a survey of the whole site, with general dimensions and setting of each building; water theatre from a Lei family drawing, Alimoff photo for the west basin of 海晏堂, engravings for planting.
reconstructions.licence: none stated on the Persee page

reconstructions.title: “再现圆明园” 数字导览系统: 12 scenes, 40 planned
reconstructions.creator: 郭黛姮 team; 孙慧皎 (清城睿现) on the technical side
reconstructions.archive: 清华大学; 清华控股 清城睿现数字科技研究院; 圆明园管理处
reconstructions.why: Three chief sources named: excavation data, the 样式房 drawings, and the 烫样 kept in the Palace Museum; plus drone survey, laser scanning, virtual fitting of broken stones and reconstructed 彩画.

reconstructions.title: Digital restoration research and 3D model of Xieqiqu, ISPRS Annals II-5/W3
reconstructions.creator: M. Gao, W. Piao, J. Guo
reconstructions.why: The Yuanmingyuan Digital Restoration Research Project of 2013 covered five of thirteen 西洋楼 scenes in its first two years: 谐奇趣, 海晏堂, 方外观, 蓄水楼, 观水法. The paper explains 谐奇趣's method: present-day survey with archival drawings and engravings.
reconstructions.licence: CC BY 3.0 on the paper; Figs 2, 4b, 5, 7, 8a, 10 and 11 credited elsewhere; the free figures have their own rows
